reason.conclusion: The registered temporal validation design cannot be reconstructed from official train because the reference Date field is unavailable. No temporal proxy will be assumed without train-only evidence.

validation_split_override.subject_normalization: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse, repeated leading Re: removed
validation_split_override.assignment: Within each category, deterministically shuffle whole thread groups with seed 42 and assign whole groups to validation until validation contains at least 15% of that category's source documents. Never split a group.

failure_rule: After Revision 2 production freeze, run the held-out test exactly once. If any assignment threshold fails, publish both Revision 1 and Revision 2 results and stop; no third test run is permitted.
